```python
# filename: oldest_bluray_from_group.py
import pandas as pd

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
format_markers = {'DVD','Blu-Ray','VHS','CD','Digital'}

current = None
formats = []
for t in df['Title'].astype(str):
    tt = t.strip()
    if tt in format_markers:
        current = tt
        formats.append(current)
    else:
        formats.append(current)

df['Format'] = formats

bluray_df = df[(df['Format']=='Blu-Ray') & (~df['Title'].isin(format_markers))].copy()
bluray_df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(bluray_df['Year'], errors='coerce')
bluray_df = bluray_df.dropna(subset=['Year'])

oldest_year = bluray_df['Year'].min()
oldest_title = bluray_df.loc[bluray_df['Year']==oldest_year, 'Title'].iloc[0]

print('Oldest Blu-Ray year:', oldest_year)
print('Oldest Blu-Ray title:', oldest_title)
```
